title: HitsPerPage widget width doesn't follow the content
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

bug

**What is the current behavior?**

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6885378/20833501/588f2576-b890-11e6-9a24-ea6fe5f76d7e.png)

Seems to do that only on certain content width and only on Chrome.

**What is the expected behavior?**

The select width should follow the option content.
